method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Constructs the WZ director-stage strip from backing, stage indicators, pulsing fourth stage and two localized text fields. It records exact visual/material/layout effects, installs the existing close hook, runs optional PostLoadFunc and returns self. No stage progression or result producer exists in this selected constructor.

summary.answer: Constructs Stage6, Stage5 and Stage4 bars in that source order at distinct positions, registers close, optional PostLoadFunc and returns self. Despite the Pulsing name no timer or pulse behavior is authored by this constructor span.
